name: VIGIL — UPI transfer to an account without completed KYC
description: Raises an alert for any UPI transfer whose beneficiary account carries kyc_verified:false. In a regulated entity this is a control exception in its own right, independent of whether an intrusion occurred, which is why it is a separate rule at medium severity rather than a condition folded into the intrusion chain. The KYC flag is synthetic upstream context, not a live CKYC registry lookup.
query: labels.dataset: "vigil-synthetic" and event.category: web and event.action: upi_transfer and vigil.bank.kyc_verified: false
